Header [⋯] (sketch L663): §7 gives it no name and no action; E11-D04's actions-column header ⋯ opens the column picker (E11-D04 §5.3 L221), and the panel's own controls are E25-D02's (§1.2 L111-112). Drawn as sketched, without behaviour.

Max ratio's accessible description for the 13:20 sell row: §7.1 L675-676 gives the form (bid first for sell) and only the buy example 'ask 228 vs bid 38, ratio 6.0 to 1'; the sell stack's bid and ask volumes are not in the spec. The description is not visible, so nothing is drawn; annotated by its form only.

deviations: Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.
'Active in semibold' (§7.1 L678) is drawn in type.ui.body-strong (medium): no semibold 13 px token exists; the word carries the state.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).

The SCR-056 panel is drawn maximised in the 1280 × 800 frame (1,280 × 800), as §3 L177-178 draws SCR-030's chart panel: §0 L30-32 and §7 give the frame size and 'a neutral panel frame' (L661; §1.2 L110) but no panel size, and a docked workspace narrows it. With two rows shown the panel is empty below the E25-D02 band. The locate target, a BTCUSDT 5m SCR-030 pane, is taken as open outside the frame (block-01), so every row locates and §7.3's shared reason under the caption (L704-705) is not drawn; board 51 draws it.

Column widths: §7 gives the columns, not their widths (the kit's COLS_056 note). The kit's 616 px of data columns are about the sketch's proportions (L663: 8 / 19 / 23 / 12 / 8 / 16 characters, then 6 for [⋯]); gen_13.py fit_columns() scales them × 1.974 to 111 / 268 / 300 / 158 / 126 / 253 px so the table spans the panel's 1,256 px inner width with the kit's 40 px [⋯] column at its right edge, as the sketch draws it (L663-665); the kit's builder keeps 656 px of columns in any width.

The header's [⋯] (sketch L663) is drawn as the rows' glyph (more-horizontal, the dark grey) centred in the row-menu column (gen_13.py header_menu()); the kit's header leaves that cell empty. §7 gives it no name and no action (copy gap).

Comfortable follows one rule over the whole table, E11-D04 §2's comfortable column for its CMP-049 table (E11-D04 L97-100; E11-D02 D6, §6 L216, steps the chrome the same way): a 32 px header, rows and checkbox (size.row.comfortable; 24 px at compact, `16` §3 L113-114); type.num.base numbers (Time, Price range, Max ratio, Age); type.ui.body header labels, filter caption, side words and checkbox label; 12 px padding each side of every data cell (E11-D04's space.3 12, bound as space.inset.md) and none on the header and rows (gen_13.py comfort_table(): the kit's table draws type.num.sm numbers, type.ui.label headers, a type.ui.caption caption and 4 + 8 px padding at both densities). The status words keep the kit's type.ui.body-strong / type.ui.body; the title and the E25-D02 band (a placeholder, not table copy) keep the kit's type; the panel's 12 px padding is E11-D04's comfortable panel inset (L98); the 40 × 32 [⋯] cells hold E11-D04's 32 × 32 action button (L101), drawn as its glyph. `16` §3 rule 1 (L125) changes spacing only: if the owner rules it to the letter, the type returns to compact's and only the padding steps.

The 13:05 ▲ BUY stack ×5 Broken row (L666) is not drawn: the sketch writes it in parentheses ('Broken: hidden') because 'Only unfilled' hides broken rows (§7.2 L689); the caption counts it (L690-691). Board 50 draws the filter's own state.
